  - heading "Take action with Storage Intelligence" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - text: Simplify management of your Cloud Storage at scale with
    - link "Storage Intelligence":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/storage-intelligence/overview
    - text: . Storage Intelligence eliminates manual storage management practices. This unified management product offers multiple powerful features to analyze large storage estates and easily take actions. Analyze object and bucket metadata to derive cost and security insights about your data through
    - link "Insights Datasets":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/insights/datasets
    - text: . Use Gemini Cloud Assist to generate insights with natural language conversations. Perform actions at-scale on millions of objects with zero or no code with
    - link "Batch Operations":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/batch-operations/overview
    - text: and minimize application downtime by moving entire buckets with just two commands, while preserving bucket name with
    - link "Bucket Relocation":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/bucket-relocation/overview
    - text: .
  - link "ESG logo Discover how Google Cloud's smart storage is getting customers ready for the AI era. Read ESG’s Showcase report.":
    - /url: https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/google_cloud_smart_storage_esg.pdf
    - img "ESG logo"
    - text: Discover how Google Cloud's smart storage is getting customers ready for the AI era. Read ESG’s Showcase report.
  - heading "Accelerate your data access" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - text: Enhance the performance of demanding applications with
    - link "Rapid Cache":
      - /url: https://docs.cloud.google.com/storage/docs/rapid/rapid-cache
    - text: ", a fully managed, intelligent SSD-backed read cache for Region, Dual-region, or Multi-region buckets. Combined with Multi-region buckets, Rapid Cache brings your data closer to compute resources in any zone where your TPUs/GPUs are available, giving you low latency and high throughput of up to 20 Tbps for AI/ML and data analytics workloads. Benefit from minimizing your network egress costs when accessing data across a continent without the need for provisioning or managing a separate storage tier."
  - heading "Object- and bucket-level permissions" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - link "Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM)":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/access-control/using-iam-permissions
    - text: allows you to control who has access to your buckets and objects.
  - heading "Leading analytics and ML/AI tools" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - text: Once your data is stored in Cloud Storage, easily plug into Google Cloud’s powerful tools to create your
    - link "data warehouse":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery
    - text: with BigQuery, run
    - link "open source analytics":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/dataproc
    - text: with Managed Service for Apache Spark, or build and deploy
    - link "machine learning (ML) models":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/products/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform
    - text: with Gemini platform. The
    - link "Data Agent Kit":
      - /url: https://docs.cloud.google.com/data-cloud-extension
    - text: streamlines your workflows by bundling secure
    - link "Model Context Protocol":
      - /url: https://modelcontextprotocol.io/docs/getting-started/intro
    - text: (MCP) tools, native IDE plugins, and pre-codified data engineering, data science, and data app developer skills into a single, open-source package.
  - link "BigQuery magnifying glass Start querying Cloud Storage data with BigQuery":
    - /url: https://cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/external-data-cloud-storage
    - img "BigQuery magnifying glass"
    - text: Start querying Cloud Storage data with BigQuery
  - heading "Automatic storage class transitions" [level=3]
  - paragraph:
    - text: With features like
    - link "Object Lifecycle Management (OLM)":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/lifecycle
    - text: and
    - link "Autoclass":
      - /url: https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/autoclass
    - text: you can easily optimize costs with object placement across storage classes. You can enable, at the bucket level, policy-based automatic object movement to colder storage classes based on the last access time. There are no early deletion or retrieval fees, nor class transition charges for object access in colder storage classes.
